content:
The **Billings Homestead** is a location in The Forest region of Appalachia. It is a Public Workshop with claim and defend events.

A simple two-story farmhouse with no basement with two Ash Roses and two Blackberry bushes in the backyard. There is random loot inside and a locked (Picklock 2) Safe on the second floor. The fields around the house contain more than 40 Razorgrain.

The Workshop is outside against the south wall of the house along with an Armor Workbench. The suitcase beside the Armor Workbench provides access to the player character's Stash Box. There is a Poseidon Power Box near the Workshop which provides 10 units of power.

North of this homestead and south of Silva Homestead there is a single silo with a large semi-circular shed immediately adjacent to it. While it is equally close to both, it appears to actually belong to Silva - the door faces Silva and the land between the barn and Silva's farmhouse is tilled. Inside the shed, one has a chance to find Power Armor at the Power Armor Station.

The Billings Homestead appears in *Fallout 76*.
